description: What the person has made selling on agentPickup's marketplace: each item handed over, with its price, agentPickup's 2.5% fee, Stripe's card fee, what they got and when it reaches their Stripe balance; payments still held until a handover; and, from Stripe, their balance, recent payouts to their bank and the bank account (last four digits only). Casual sellers have no Stripe dashboard, so this is where they see their money: present it however suits them (a table, totals, a chart). If Stripe needs anything more from them, start_selling gives a fresh Stripe link. Needs sign-in.
name: my_payouts
title: My sales money
